title: Courant-sharp hat
why: Pleijel/Faber-Krahn bound plus validated numerics; finite rigorous computation for fixed polygon.

title: The 89–233 basin
why: Each preimage set finite (Størmer); need infinite backward tree, no known handle.

title: Finitely many loops for affine prime maps
why: Fixed/2-cycles trivially finite; long cycles Collatz-like, may even fail for some a,b.

title: Missing digits in two bases
why: Maynard-type Fourier for two independent bases at once; hard but plausibly reachable.

title: Square-plus-one orbit mod 3
why: Orbit of 2 grows erratically; even unboundedness unprovable, residue control hopeless.

title: Triangles through every vertex of S_N
why: x²+y²−z²=2n; take x−z=1, odd 2n−y²: explicit construction.

title: Clique minors of the prime-sum graph
why: Thomason plus edge count give n/polylog; pseudorandomness likely pins order like G(n,p).

title: Seven-free Friedlander–Iwaniec primes
why: Combining FI sparse-prime sieve with Maynard digit restriction; far beyond current methods.
